title: Algorithm Assimilator
keywords: Collects pear/diamond tree products into its bulk bins when its adjacent tree satisfies the program

blocks.text: Collects pear/diamond tree products into its bulk bins when its adjacent tree satisfies the program.

rows: Place beside the three-block trunk, facing away.
Maintain a valid tree with the required leaf count.
Let leaves mature and withdraw products from the bins.

blocks.text: This collects configured tree products, not arbitrary drops from any modded tree.
